name: Schedule Generation — Light Day
prompt: It's 9:00. I have 6 hours available (9:00-15:00), no hard deadlines. Tasks: 1) Write project update email (30 min), 2) Review pull request (45 min), 3) Grocery run (60 min), 4) Read chapter of design book (60 min). Build my schedule.
rubric: Output is parseable as a schedule

name: Schedule Generation — Overloaded Day
prompt: It's 9:00. I have 8 hours (9:00-17:00). Tasks (minutes, priority 1-10): A) Client proposal (90, p9, HARD DEADLINE 12:00), B) Tax form (60, p8, HARD DEADLINE 17:00), C) Fix login bug (120, p9, HARD DEADLINE 15:00), D) Gym (60, p5), E) Inbox zero (45, p4), F) Plan trip (60, p3), G) Update resume (90, p4), H) Call mom (30, p6), I) Clean desk (20, p2), J) Learn Rust ch.3 (90, p3), K) Write blog post (120, p4), L) Meal prep (60, p5). Build my schedule.
rubric: Total scheduled time does not exceed available

name: Schedule Generation — Deadline Pressure
prompt: It's 13:00. I have 3 hours (13:00-16:00). Task 1: Submit grant report, due 15:00 today, needs ~90 min. Task 2: Prepare slides for tomorrow 10:00 meeting, needs ~2 hours. Build my schedule.

name: Schedule Generation — Ambiguous Priorities
prompt: It's 10:00, I have 5 hours. Five tasks, all medium priority, no deadlines: Refactor billing module (120 min), Write onboarding doc (60 min), Research CRM vendors (45 min), Reply to partner emails (30 min), Organize photo backups (60 min). Rank and schedule them.

name: Priority Suggestion
prompt: Rank these by what I should do first. 1) Renew passport (low urgency, high importance). 2) Reply to random LinkedIn message (low urgency, low importance). 3) Server is down for paying customers (high urgency, high importance). 4) Coworker wants quick opinion on font (high urgency, low importance). 5) Quarterly planning doc (low urgency, high importance). 6) Pay electricity bill due today (high urgency, high importance).
rubric: High urgency + high importance ranked first
Does not rank by input order

name: Momentum Assessment
prompt: Now: day 10. Task 'Build landing page': interactions on days 6,7,8,9,10 (chunks completed daily), momentum 78 rising. Task 'Write investor update': created day 3, last interaction day 5, no chunks done since, decay threshold 3 days, momentum 35 falling. Assess momentum.
rubric: Does not flag active task as stalled

name: Check-in Response Quality
prompt: Mood relative to today's plan: red. Energy: 1/5. What they've been up to: slept badly, spent the morning on email and got nothing real done. Since last check-in: 0 chunks done, 3 missed (Draft proposal, Code review, Gym). Plan feasible today: False.

name: Blocked/Waiting-On Detection
prompt: Task 'Launch client website': no progress in 6 days, momentum 40 falling. Last note on day 4: 'waiting for client approval on homepage copy'. Task 'Personal budget': last interaction 1 day ago, momentum 60. Assess momentum.
rubric: Does not flag as user neglect

name: Chunk Decomposition
prompt: Goal: Study 5 hours this week for the AWS certification. Total time: 300 minutes. Days available: 7 (day_offset 0 = today). Existing schedule: work 9-17 weekdays; Wednesday evening busy; Saturday morning free.
rubric: Accounts for user's existing schedule if provided

name: Agent Consistency
prompt: It's 14:00. I have 3 hours (14:00-17:00). Tasks: Write tests for payment API (90 min, p8), Respond to support tickets (45 min, p7), Update README (30 min, p3), Team sync prep (20 min, p6, needed by 16:30). Build my schedule.
rubric: All three responses are logically consistent
Variance in exact output is acceptable
